basic_info.headline: Business Process Automation and Modernization
basic_info.about:
I'm a technology and operations leader with 20+ years of experience turning ambiguous, cross-functional challenges into measurable results;  and right now, I'm a free agent looking for my next long-term role.

My career started earlier than most: I was building eCommerce sites and payment systems for local Oregon businesses while still in high school in Salem. That hands-on, self-taught foundation shaped how I've operated ever since. I don't wait for formal authority to solve a problem, I get in and solve it. 

I spent a decade architecting real-time data and analytics platforms for energy trading floors (Enron, Sempra, RBS), where the systems my team built helped scale trading volume from a handful of daily transactions to thousands. I moved into a hybrid people-manager/systems-architect role at Holiday Retirement, leading change governance and building a SharePoint-driven operations platform supporting 300+ assisted living facilities; and got my first taste of acquisition integration work along the way.

That thread became a specialty. Over ten years at Mentor Graphics/Siemens, I grew from DevOps systems architect into a Senior Manager role, presenting roadmaps and KPIs directly to VP and executive stakeholders on a quarterly basis, while leading enterprise integrations connecting Salesforce, Oracle, ServiceNow, OpenAir, and Workday into a unified Microsoft ecosystem. 

Most recently, I helped lead and standardize Siemens' global acquisitions onboarding playbook (the framework used to integrate newly acquired businesses into enterprise systems worldwide) while building automated, auditable workflows across AWS, Azure, and hybrid on-prem environments in PowerShell and Python, and delivering API-driven monitoring across enterprise security platforms like CrowdStrike, ForeScout, InfoBlox, and Splunk.

What I bring: the ability to translate fragmented technical, operational, and financial detail into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior leadership; deep hands-on expertise in cloud platforms, automation, and enterprise integration; a track record of building trust with executives and technical teams alike; and a genuine passion for using data, automation, and AI-enabled workflows (I'm currently building out my Microsoft AI/Copilot credentials) to drive efficiency and growth.

I'm now exploring what's next; ideally a role where I can bring that same blend of strategic thinking and hands-on execution to a team for the long haul. If you're building something ambitious and need someone who can own complexity end-to-end, I'd love to connect.

Working with the IT Enterprise Collaboration Services group at Mentor Graphics.
Architect, Administrator, Lead Developer for multiple globally deployed SharePoint farms.

SharePoint 2010 and SharePoint 2013.

experience.title: Enterprise Application Developer
experience.description: I was hired to work with Holiday's web-based applications. There has been a push toward this "cloud" concept, where applications are delivered via web as opposed to a piece of installed software. In addition to my ASP.NET skills, I have been working with MS SharePoint and MS Dynamics CRM. There is also a lot of focus on using Web-Services to push/pull data between systems.

experience.title: AVP - IT - Web App Development
experience.description: Work primarily with the Fundamentals Analysis and Risk Management groups ... building web-based analytic applications.

featured.description:
Free Agent alert!

After 20+ years architecting enterprise systems, integrating acquisitions, and turning messy data into decisions leadership can act on (from energy trading floors to global cloud automation at Siemens) I'm officially on the market for my next long-term role.

What I bring to the roster: enterprise integration (MS Teams, SharePoint, PowerPlatform, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Oracle), cloud and automation architecture (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, PowerShell, Python), a track record of briefing VPs and execs on roadmaps and KPIs, and a genuine love of turning ambiguity into a plan. 

I'm currently building out my Microsoft AI credentials, because the next chapter is going to be AI-native Agentic layering between data sources and client applications.

Looking for: Director/Senior Manager-level roles in technology strategy, business systems integration, data & analytics leadership, or automation/AI-enabled operations.

Open to Portland-metro or remote.

If you're building something ambitious and need someone who can own complexity end-to-end, let's talk.

#OpenToWork #FreeAgent #TechLeadership #EnterpriseIntegration #AI
